name: Detect Evil and Good

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Self; locate Aberration/Celestial/Elemental/Fey/Fiend/Undead and active Hallow spell within 30 feet; blocked by one foot stone/dirt/wood, one inch metal or thin lead; no alignment inference or invented general consecration fact.

rules.text: For the duration, you sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet of yourself.
You also sense whether the Hallow spell is active there and, if so, where.
The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
